  "prompt": "Use case: illustration-story.
Create ONE finished key plate for the human in a silent animated film, shot s01, key K2 (grip, frame 42). Single full-length figure on a pure opaque black field. One thin pale baseline directly under the boots and the cream text "K2" centered below that line. No other text, no props, no scenery, no inset, no duplicate figure, no construction diagram.
REFERENCE ROLES: Image 1 is the approved MODEL SHEET and the authority for exact character identity, proportions and pigments. Image 2 is the approved rendering pick and the authority for line quality, tapered tips and stipple shadow. Preserve the same green skin, mauve-and-blue angular poncho with cream panels, ONE trailing swoop of cream-and-mauve hair, oversized hands, long thin limbs, flared trousers and heeled boots. Anatomical proportions approximately eight heads tall. Use the exact flat identity pigments from the references, thin pale contour approximately 1/166 of figure height, delicate tapered tips, controlled stipple shadows. No gradients or painterly shading. Do not copy reference sheets or their multiple views.
COMPOSITION: A single complete figure including the whole hair
